x: However, the main part of the season is yet to come and he should find some tough cross-country races a valuable background to his road-running, as have Jack Holden, Jim Peters and Fred Norris before him!

On the next leg T.V.H. pulled out their trump card in the form of Mike Wiggs who with a great run knocked off 10 secs. from Jim Peters's stage record set in 1953 and this time in turn was bettered by Bruce Tulloh running in the lead position who ran even 30 secs. faster than Wiggs.
This might be a reason why no Englishman has ever been successful in the race, the highest placing being second by Jim Peters in 1954, beaten by Finland's Veikko Karvonen.
Incidentally, the main team trophy is named after one of the marathon "greats" - Jim Peters. Laurie once again had a recall to the table for the Vet's Prize.
